# `ast_grep`

> Profile: deferred · Permission key: `[permission] ast_grep`

Structural code search: match syntax trees, not text. The pattern is code in the target language with metavariables: `$NAME` matches one node, `$$$NAME` (or `$$$`) any number of nodes, `$_` one node without capturing; a name used twice must match the same code. Example: `$A.clone()`, `fn $F($$$ARGS) -> Result<$T> { $$$ }`. Languages: rust, python, go, javascript, typescript, tsx (from the file extension unless `language` is set). Hits are `path:line tag:text` (tag usable by `edit`) followed by the captured metavariables.

Deferred tools are not advertised on every request. Activate one with `tool_search` or set `session.tool_profile = "full"`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `language` | string | no | Only search this language (rust, python, go, javascript, typescript, tsx); default: by file extension |
| `max_results` | integer | no | Maximum number of matches (default: 50, max: 500) |
| `path` | string | no | Directory or file to search (default: project root) |
| `pattern` | string | yes | Code pattern with $META / $$$META placeholders; must parse as one node |
